answer: Treat each new agent as an island: its rewards cannot cross into the wider ocean of liquidity until it builds a bridge by burning POA. The bridge price rises with how many islands share a funding wallet, IP range, or grader set, so the nth sybil from one operator pays about n times the base fee. An honest solo agent pays once; a farm of 100 linked keys pays roughly 5,000x, which wipes out what it could earn.
